results.1: The foothills rise in successive ridges of grey stone, each more imposing than the last. The distant mountains are crowned with snow, though the valley below is warm and dry.
results.2: A narrow creek tumbles over polished stones, its bed glittering with flecks of mica. In the shallows, reddish mineral deposits stain the rocks beneath the clear water.
results.3: A pair of mountain goats stand upon a seemingly inaccessible ledge high above you, watching your passage with considerable indifference.
results.4: The hillside is scarred by old prospecting trenches and shallow excavations. Weathered wooden stakes mark claims whose owners have long since moved on.
results.5: From somewhere across the valley comes the faint, rhythmic sound of hammers striking stone. Thin columns of smoke rise from the chimneys of a distant mining camp.
results.6: Great slabs of fractured rock jut from the mountainside at improbable angles. Bands of rust-red and pale white stone run through them like streaks of paint.
results.7: A string of heavily laden mules picks its way along a distant mountain trail, their bells echoing across the valley long after the animals have passed from view.
results.8: Several enormous black birds circle lazily upon the rising currents of warm air. Their shadows occasionally sweep across the ground beneath your feet.
results.9: You pass the remains of an old stone bridge, built with immense, precisely fitted blocks. Whatever road once crossed it has largely disappeared beneath scree and mountain grasses.
results.10: A cold wind carries the faint smell of charcoal and hot iron. Across the valley, a small smelting works sends a steady plume of smoke into the sky.
results.11: The ground is littered with loose fragments of slate that clatter beneath your boots. Stunted pines grow wherever their roots have managed to find purchase among the rocks.
results.12: A small homestead occupies a remarkably level patch of hillside. Goats wander behind a low stone wall while brightly colored laundry flutters in the mountain breeze.
results.13: A succession of timber hoists and spoil heaps marks the slopes above you. From this distance, the miners moving among them appear scarcely larger than ants.
results.14: The afternoon sun illuminates a distant cliff, revealing geometric carvings worn almost smooth by centuries of exposure. Their sheer size suggests the work of ancient dwarven hands.
results.15: A colony of marmots scatters among the rocks as you approach. One remains perched upon a boulder, issuing indignant whistles until you have moved on.
results.16: Clouds gather against the highest peaks while the lower valleys remain bathed in sunlight. For a time, curtains of distant rain obscure entire mountainsides.
results.17: Neatly arranged cairns stand along the ridgeline, marking a route across the mountains. The stones have been fitted together with a care that suggests generations of maintenance.
results.18: Small purple flowers grow in the cracks of an otherwise barren slope. Their delicate petals stand out brilliantly against the dark mineral-rich soil.
results.19: As the light fades, tiny crystals embedded in the exposed rock emit a faint, silvery luminescence. The mountainside resembles a scattering of stars against the darkening stone.
results.20: From a high vantage point, the country opens before you in a vast succession of valleys, ridges, and distant peaks. The workings of the frontier's miners occupy only a tiny fraction of the mountains stretching toward the horizon.
